    AI Overview

    AI Mode replied:

    There is no official Android APK for DLSS 5, as NVIDIA DLSS (Deep Learning Super Sampling) is a desktop PC graphics technology for Windows and PC hardware. 
    If you are looking for desktop PC management tools, DLSS 5 features are managed via Windows applications rather than mobile Android APK files: 
    • DLSS 5 Swapper: A Windows PC tool used to manage and inject DLSS 5 neural rendering and files into compatible games or emulators. You can find PC versions via platforms like DLSS 5 Swapper on Uptodown or TechSpot. 
    • NVIDIA Developer Plugins: Official plugins and SDK packages for PC developers are hosted directly on the NVIDIA Developer RTX/DLSS Page. 
    Caution:
    Any mobile file labeled as a "DLSS 5 APK" online is unofficial, fake, and likely malicious or deceptive, as DLSS does not run on mobile Android operating systems. 
    Are you trying to run a specific upscaling or graphics tool on a Windows PC, or did you mean a different mobile app or framework?
